body: Deep-dive-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Live deep dive #8, company drawn at random (seed 20261205) from IT / FMCG / Consumer Durables names in the Rs 1,000-20,000 cr band (method test, L9/L21). Probability 0.45 (naive base rate 0.67) that: Uttam Sugar FY27 consolidated revenue from operations is >= Rs 2,200 cr (FY26 2,201.65). Our reasoning: H1 FY27 1,100.4 (-9% y/y); H2 needs >= 1,100 vs 991 in H2 FY26 (+11%): plausible on price and a bigger crop but release quotas and lower ethanol cut against it. Naive base: Revenue grew in 7 of 10 FYs FY17-26 [SCR] (Laplace 8/12 = 0.67). Resolution: YES if FY27 consolidated revenue from operations, as first reported, is >= Rs 2,200 cr. Source: NSE integrated-filing XBRL (consolidated) / screener consolidated. Resolve by 2027-05-31; score with Brier vs the base rate.
